title: Jagged Crispy Mexican Chicken Mole Poblano
description: A charred and crispy Mexican dish featuring chicken in a rich mole poblano sauce, energizing the taste buds with a blend of spices and powdered sugar, Bhuna style cooking adds depth to the dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken pieces to the skillet and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the mole poblano paste, bhuna spice mix, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the powdered sugar.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
